title: COMBIN: 6 of 16 discriminating pairs, and the earlier exactness claim withdrawn
status_plain: A design-for-divergence capture corrected an earlier over-claim that COMBIN agreed with Excel below 2^53 -- an over-claim that rested on a non-discriminating seven-point corpus. On 16 deliberately discriminating (n,k) pairs Excel matches the shipped multiply-first kernel on 6. `(acc*(n-k+i))/i` is verbatim the shipped `combinations_of_int`, so this is a production count on this surface, not a refutation of a candidate. The 82/505 in the same lane IS a candidate score and is carried separately. The positive structural finding is that Excel reduces k to min(k, n-k).
